claim: Defines clip c_i as the set of T_C consecutive frames starting at frame k within video V.
Defines the anticipation window AW_i as the Delta frames immediately following clip c_i.
Defines the unlabeled dataset D_U as the videos in D_100K used in neither the spotting-model nor the classification-model training sets.
Effective frame rate after temporal downsampling equals the original fps divided by the temporal stride.
Binary cross-entropy loss for offline action anticipation over N training samples with ground-truth labels y_i and predicted probabilities yhat_i.
Class-weighted cross-entropy loss for online action anticipation over V videos and C classes.
Frame-normalized class-weighted cross-entropy loss for action spotting, so each frame contributes equally to the loss.
Min-max normalization of the class activation map over time, height, and width, with epsilon guarding against division by zero.
